answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 31366 Country: India Title: Dream Question: I m 20 years Muslim girl nd my name is samiya n m frm India. I m engagd with my mum's cousin bro since 5 yrs bt i m in a relationship wid a Hindu guy. v r truly in love wd each other nd want to marry each other. bt my parents r nt accepting my relationship. thus i did istikhara nd my question was with whome i'll get married? 1st day i saw a hindu guy in my dream fighting with me.... 2nd day i saw nothing on my dream bt on 3rd day i saw a snake in my dream it was crawling on me nd i frightnd bt snake said i"ll not harm u.. after that another snake enttered in my house nd he goes towards my living room. I went there along wid my elder sistr to see dt snake bt it was disappeard nd swastik (hindu religious sign) was there on sofa nd floor after that i saw a snake again and my elder sister killed that snake. after that i woke up nd got scared... Can u plz tell me wat is the meaning of these dreams?? I was very confused at that time aftr a month again i did istikhara nd my question was same. That time i saw me and my boyfriend were riding on a bike 2nd day i saw me and my boyfrnd were making love with each other in a hoouse 3rd day again it was the same thing happining in my dream. I am very much confused. What should i do?? I dnt want to leave him i hd done abortion few months ago. I truly love him. Plz guide me and tell me whats d right path for me and also tell me what does these istikhara dreams meant? Answer ID: 31366 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 528/L/128/tl=1432) You should obey your parents regarding the marriage and keep your emotions under control. The betterment of this world and the hereafter lies in obeying parents. Your dreams indicate to the same. Note: It is haram to marry a Hindu boy, it is not lawful; hence, you should never think of marrying a Hindu boy in any case. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
